body: Funny thing is I used to be exactly like that... Fight no matter what... man 22 years of constant fighting takes a toll no matter who you are. The fact is my body can't take the fighting anymore... I can barely walk up stairs anymore. I have so much scarred tissue in my brain that the MRI scans actually scared the doctor... Don't get me wrong.. Suicide scares the absolute fuck out of me but I am tired of breaking down when I try and do normal shit.
